blocks.title: Combine the latest values

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `BehaviorSubject` keeps a current value and immediately sends it to a new subscriber.
`combineLatest` waits for a value from every input, then emits their latest values when an input changes.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: The output is 20, then 30 after books changes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A source with no first value can make the combined stream wait. Know which inputs have emitted.
